tools.name: find-spots
tools.description: Find outdoor table-tennis spots near a coordinate. Returns the nearest spots with their distance and a citable url.

tools.name: get-spot
tools.description: Get one spot with details and nearby spots, by slug (preferred) or raw id.

tools.name: playing-conditions
tools.description: Current outdoor playing conditions (wind, temperature, precipitation) for a location. Wind is the decisive signal for outdoor table tennis.
